posted.headline: Reliance Prepares ₹36,000-Crore Jio Platforms IPO for Launch on October 21
posted.post:
India’s primary market is about to face its biggest liquidity test yet.

Reliance Industries is preparing to launch the initial public offering of **Jio Platforms** on October 21, targeting an issue size of approximately **₹36,000 crore ($3.8 billion)**. Trading is scheduled to begin on domestic bourses around October 28.

At this scale, the offering will become the largest IPO in Indian capital market history.

**Why it matters:**

• **Conglomerate Unbundling:** The listing establishes a pure-play, standalone market valuation for India’s dominant digital and telecom ecosystem, marking a crucial value-unlocking phase for Reliance Industries.
• **Primary Market Depth:** Mobilizing ₹36,000 crore will directly test the absorption capacity of both domestic institutions and global funds, setting a new benchmark for mega-cap issuances in India.
• **Digital Re-rating:** It shifts Jio from a conglomerate-held division to an independently traded digital powerhouse.

*Keep in mind:* Final price bands, quota allocations, and the definitive launch timeline remain subject to pending SEBI and regulatory clearances.
